copier.description: Template updates are the monthly manual copier sweep (handbook/cadences.md), not Renovate PRs. Generated repos record their source as gh:willzhu16/platform, which Renovate cannot look up, so leaving this on only adds a lookup warning to every dashboard.

packageRules.description: Batch minor/patch/pin/digest updates into one weekly PR (D-11 grouping value).

Hold pnpm below 12. pnpm 12 writes a new lockfile format that osv-scanner reads only a sliver of: on 2026-10-26 the pnpm 12 PRs scanned 15 packages where the current lockfile has 294 (athena) and 186 (canary-worker), so security / osv passed without checking dependencies. Lift once osv-scanner reads the new format.
Surface platform reusable-workflow major bumps on their own PR (D-18 migration = one line).
